title: Hello, Serial
summary: Talk to your computer over the serial port.
goal: Print "Hello, Cubot!" once at startup, then print "tick" every second.
brief:
The serial port is how a board tells you what it is doing. It is your first debugging tool.

1. Start the port in `setup()` with `Serial.begin(9600)`. 9600 is the **baud rate**: bits per second.
2. Print `Hello, Cubot!` once with `Serial.println`.
3. In `loop()`, print `tick` and wait one second.

The text is checked exactly, including the capital letters and the comma.
hints: Nothing is printed until the serial port has been started.
Serial.begin(9600); goes first in setup(). Serial.println("...") prints a line.
setup(): Serial.begin(9600); Serial.println("Hello, Cubot!");  loop(): Serial.println("tick"); delay(1000);
